item.title: Understanding the Entrepreneurial Motivations, Dynamics, and Outcomes of First Fridays, Festivals, Farmer's Markets and other Community Events
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines entrepreneurial dimensions of community events such as First Fridays, festivals, and farmer's markets. It seeks to understand the motivations driving entrepreneurs to participate in these events, the dynamics of how these events operate and evolve, and their outcomes for entrepreneurs and communities.

Appel publié par Journal of Business Venturing Insights. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
